notes: Local firmware files now show their release notes, wiseTool recognizes WiseGPO serial devices, and OTA completion reporting is more reliable.
added: Local OTA files display embedded What's new and Fixes notes before installation.
wiseTool automatically refreshes serial ports and selects a connected WiseGPO.
Recognized WiseGPO serial ports are labeled beside their COM port.
fixed: Local firmware selection now provides meaningful release information instead of only the filename.
Completed OTA transfers are no longer reported as connection failures when the unit restarts.
